title: Pasco County School Board, District 3
what_it_does: School board members set the district budget and school-tax rate, hire the superintendent (where appointed), approve school boundaries, curriculum policy and construction, and set district policies. Nonpartisan.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); both candidates are marked Qualified, which for a nonpartisan seat means the August vote did not produce a majority winner (or the seat is decided only in November). Positions have not been researched; check the county Supervisor of Elections sample ballot.

candidates.name: Matt Geiger
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Educator; teacher, counselor and school administrator
candidates.background: Geiger has spent roughly 20 to 30 years in education as a teacher, counselor and administrator in public, private, charter and parochial schools, and more recently directed a soccer academy. He is a Pasco County parent and a candidate for the District 3 seat on the Nov. 3, 2026 ballot.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

teacher_pay.summary: Geiger makes increasing teacher salaries a top campaign priority and says he would pay for it by cutting central-office waste and directing more funding to classrooms and salaries. He has also proposed district-owned affordable teacher housing modeled on a Chicago program.

sources.title: Matt Geiger for Pasco County School Board - campaign site
Veterans, teachers, podcasters and constitutionalists vie for Pasco County school board seats

property_tax.summary: Geiger said he supports Pasco County's local property-tax referendum for schools, while calling it an incomplete answer to teacher retention because teachers also feel undervalued over discipline and bureaucracy.

sources.title: Veterans, teachers, podcasters and constitutionalists vie for Pasco County school board seats

school_safety.summary: Geiger lists improving classroom behavior as a priority and says discipline should be restored so teachers can teach. He has proposed school safety officers who issue citations to students for chronic misbehavior. He has not proposed added counseling or mental-health staffing.
school_safety.quote: Restore discipline so teachers can teach and students can learn.

sources.title: Matt Geiger for Pasco County School Board - campaign site

other_issues.title: Curriculum content
other_issues.summary: Geiger says schools should teach free from ideological indoctrination, emphasizing phonics-based reading, basic math proficiency and American exceptionalism, and opposes what he calls divisive social theories in the curriculum. He has not described how he would handle an individual parent's objection to a specific book.

sources.title: Veterans, teachers, podcasters and constitutionalists vie for Pasco County school board seats

other_issues.title: Career and technical education
other_issues.summary: Geiger proposes expanding career and technical education and building career-cluster programs with local businesses to prepare students for work after high school.

candidates.name: Mollyana Ward
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.background: Ward is a Pasco County real estate agent who describes herself as a business leader, mother and grandmother with experience in early childhood education and family services. She is a candidate for the District 3 seat on the Nov. 3, 2026 ballot.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

school_books.summary: Ward said book challenges should be handled through a clear, lawful process that respects both parents' rights and age-appropriate standards. She described a process rather than saying a parent's objection should by itself remove a title.
school_books.quote: Book challenges should be handled through a clear, lawful process that respects parents' rights and age-appropriate standards

sources.title: Veterans, teachers, podcasters and constitutionalists vie for Pasco County school board seats

school_safety.summary: Ward lists artificial-intelligence threat detection among her safety priorities and supports limiting cell-phone use during instruction. Her campaign site highlights the Sheriff's Office endorsement and the partnership between the Sheriff's Office and the school district. She has not proposed added counseling or mental-health staffing.

sources.title: Veterans, teachers, podcasters and constitutionalists vie for Pasco County school board seats
Mollyana Ward for Pasco County School Board District 3 - campaign site

taxes.summary: Ward says she would protect and respect every dollar in the budget by demanding efficiency, transparency and accountability, and would expand opportunities without increasing taxes. She has not called for cutting taxes or named services she would reduce.

sources.title: Mollyana Ward for Pasco County School Board District 3 - campaign site

other_issues.title: Teacher pipeline
other_issues.summary: Ward says she would strengthen local teacher pipelines through partnerships with universities, rather than focusing on pay changes.
